title: Onyx experiment manifest
description: The provenance record every campaign, benchmark report and chart must carry (L3). Results live in docs/research/results/<date>-<name>/ next to this manifest, the raw traces or their digests, summary.json and the command that regenerates each table.

context.description: The context the model ran with (B15). No number is published at an unknown context: each value is a number of tokens or an explicit null

requestedTokens.description: What Onyx asked the runtime for; null when nothing was asked and the allocation is the server's own

reportedTokens.description: What the runtime said it allocated; null when it did not say

verifiedTokens.description: What a canary probe confirmed; null when no probe confirmed the reported number

mechanism.description: How the requested context was applied, e.g. derived-model; null when nothing was requested

identifier.description: The runtime-qualified model identifier, e.g. ollama:qwen2.5-coder:7b

wireModel.description: The name requests are sent under when it is not the identifier's: a derived-model alias over the same weights (B15)

digest.description: The weights digest the runtime reports; `mock` only for the mock runtime

logprobs.description: tier S: ask the runtime for each token's log-probability and keep them in the record

hash.description: The configuration hash the trace header carries (L4 supplies the content)
A digest over the task ids and their content hashes, never the content itself

loadAverage.description: The 1, 5 and 15 minute load averages when the manifest was written. A campaign records the load again when it starts and ends (campaign.json)

power.description: The power source and adapter when the manifest was written, as the system reports them

regenerate.description: One entry per table or chart the results produce, with the command that regenerates it from the committed inputs

campaign.description: What run-lab.mts needs to run this manifest as a campaign (L9)

tier.description: S: one request a task, from plain Node. A: the agent loop inside the application

baseUrl.description: The runtime the campaign talks to. It has to be on this machine (DEC-10)

tasks.description: The task set, a file beside the manifest: commit ids and content hashes, never content

maxBeforeChars.description: A task whose file is longer than this before the change is not given to a model (the context-fit rule)

datasheets.description: A datasheet summary.json, relative to the repository, whose measured speeds the estimate uses

datasheetsFirst.description: Tier A: measure each model's datasheet in the campaign's own instance before its first unit, for a harness switch that exists only for a measured model

measure.description: Run the product's own command, Onyx: Measure Models for This Repository, in the application, in place of a task set (L11). It selects its tasks by the product's rule when it runs

revision.description: The commit the worktree is checked out at: the repository as the command sees it

datasheets.description: Measure each model's datasheet in the same instance first, so that the scorecard carries it. Default true

estimatedSeconds.description: The duration estimated from the datasheets when the manifest was written; null when no model had a measured speed

hypotheses.description: The pre-registered hypotheses this campaign tests, if any
